postal_system.assignment_rule: Only the current Posta e Kosovës assignment denominator may establish normalized XK postal-code membership and exceptions.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Only a fixed, rights-cleared and Posta-reconciled PostalZone Polygon/MultiPolygon may be drawn. A Geoportal image or point, municipality, settlement, office, address, building, parcel, buffer, hull or raster cell is never promoted by implication.
postal_system.address_rule: Postal assignment, postal-area membership, address, office and service state remain separate assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Building output requires a separately sourced explicit distributable address-building relationship or common authoritative identifier.
postal_system.administrative_rule: XK identity is preserved; source identities and territories are not changed, merged or relabelled.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Office and delivery service state are time-stamped assertions separate from area membership.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> rights-cleared Posta-reconciled postal area or explicit non-area -> address graph -> explicit building relation -> AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: normalized five-digit code -> current operator assignment and exception denominator -> valid official/derived/virtual area or explicit non-area -> address context -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: explicit distributable relation, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: All current five-digit assignments, aliases, exceptions and explicit non-area classes are fixed with dates, digests and correction policy.
Every current operator code is reconciled to one fixed PostalZone area or source-grounded non-area reason; levels and duplicate features are explained.
Every drawable record is finite, closed and valid Polygon/MultiPolygon in a declared CRS with lineage, class, date and confidence.
Assignment and geometry resources pin processing, storage, derivation, redistribution, public-serving and attribution permission.
XK and all source country/territory identities remain unchanged.
Synthetic fixtures and shared code capability never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

The current complete Kosovo five-digit postal-code assignment, alias, exception and explicit non-area denominator is pinned from Posta e Kosovës under reviewed rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every normalized code is reconciled to a fixed public official or rights-cleared Geoportal PostalZone Polygon/MultiPolygon whose feature level, parent relationship, duplicate handling, provider, edition, reference date, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method, official/derived/virtual class, confidence and exceptions are recorded, or retains a source-grounded office, P.O.-box, organization, route, point or other non-area reason. A dynamic WMS image or GetFeatureInfo response, Level-1 zone, municipality, settlement, office, address, building, parcel, point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell and synthetic fixture never becomes a complete postal perimeter by implication; XK and source identities are not changed or merged. The approved immutable artifact drives the real XK API/app, which normalizes five-digit inputs, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
Explicit address identifiers and points pass rights, schema, coverage, validity, privacy and correction gates.
Postal surfaces and building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, rights and quality gates.
